name: shrinkage-heuristic-path-token-false-positive
title: Make the DONE intent-equivalence claimsShrinkage heuristic ignore path-like/code-like tokens so file names like partial-done-recovery.ts no longer false-positive
description: The lightweight DONE intent-equivalence path in evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence (packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts, ~line 1427) scans summary.changes + actualTranscript + outcomeDiff + limitations with the trigger-word regex /\b(?:partial|narrow(?:er|ed)?|shrink(?:age|s|ing)?|out of scope|not covered|deferred|remaining|excluded)\b/i. Because '-' and '/' are word boundaries, literal file names and code identifiers match: during B-d6a0 the file name core/partial-done-recovery.ts in summary.changes matched \bpartial\b and blocked DONE with unconfirmed_single_outcome_shrinkage until the summary was reworded to avoid naming the file it changed. Fix: sanitize path-like/code-like tokens (backticked spans, segments/with/slashes, hyphenated or dotted file-name tokens) out of the text before applying the trigger regex, add a regression test whose summary names partial-done-recovery.ts, and make an explicit decision about whether the bare trigger word 'remaining' is too broad (an earlier B-d6a0 draft tripped on 'remaining' while describing pre-existing unrelated suite failures).
